title: WaterColor "Resting Beach Space" 121 Winterberry Circle
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS: *Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 10 amenity access bands.**- Conveniently located in the Crossing II District- Short bike ride to dining, shopping, pools or beach- Bar area with standalone ice maker and wine cooler- 4 adult bikes provided- 6 Seater Low-Speed Vehicle- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutGuests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Located in the Crossing II District, this custom built four bedroom is in the most private portion of WaterColor with easy access to WaterColor Crossings and Publix. This home has luxury features such as beautiful white oak flooring, a stylish granite kitchen counter top. It's just a short bike ride or drive to the beaches, pools, dining or shopping. A stay in this accommodation will give you the best value and access to all the great amenities at WaterColor. This is a beautifully appointed, bright, comfortable, four-bedroom home bordered on three sides by a nature sanctuary. The living, dining, and kitchen area is located on the first floor. The open design is perfect for family time and entertainment. Also located on the first floor is a separate bathroom with a shower and single vanity, as well as the primary bedroom with a king-sized bed and connecting bath. The remaining three bedrooms are located on the second floor of this beautiful home. Two bedrooms feature a king-size bed, and the third bedroom has a full over full bunk bed. All of the bathrooms have attached, full baths and are equipped with flat panel TV's. From the second floor, walk up the stairs to the tower cupola with a good book, and enjoy fabulous views and your favorite drink. The tower has a comfortable sleeper sofa and can serve as an additional sleeping area for guests.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS: FIRST FLOOR:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Shower/Tub Combo SECOND FLOOR:- Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only - Guest Bedroom: Full-over-Full Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboTHIRD FLOOR:- Viewing Tower: Queen Sleeper WATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS: - Named the #1 family vacation destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for family getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Pickle ball courts- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preservesWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Per HOA Policy, all golf cart rentals in WaterColor must be made through The Electric Cart Company and will be limited to 80 vehicles throughout the community at any given time. Homes are permitted one golf cart per home. Homes with owner provided golf carts are not permitted to rent an additional golf cart.
